topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture themes and outlines key learning objectives regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutational accumulation and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages during clonal cancer development.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchy and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the role of tissue hierarchies and stemness in tumor initiation using experimental evidence from leukemias and colorectal cancers.

topics.label: Microenvironmental influences and stromal support in tumor progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inflammatory promoters and supportive stroma within the microenvironment enable tumor expansion and inform therapeutic approaches.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic reviews the sequencing, mathematical modeling, and spatial profiling tools used to investigate cancer evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Integrated evolutionary model of cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the combined influences of mutational burden, cell-of-origin characteristics, and microenvironmental context on cancer progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic marks the conclusion of the lecture and introduces the topic for the subsequent session.
